name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. '04' is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 1-30), confirmed Chapter 4 '塞拉村前' via fd2-knowledge; NOT an address residue (0x32fb2 != 04). 'init' correctly reflects role as the chapter-4 prologue/init handler registered in the chapter init dispatch table at 0x51d75 (entry +8 -> 0x32fb2).
purpose: Chapter 4 (塞拉村前) init/prologue handler: plays two dialog pages bracketing one cutscene, loads portrait set 1, pans the camera between scenes, then hands the chapter to the player. No char init (party carries over from chapter 3).
logic_summary: Watcom __CHK(0x28) stack probe (not source body). Then: init battle state for chapter; pan_cursor_and_window(4,0xB); cutscene_event_trigger(0x14); display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text page 0, fixed window geometry 0xa0000/0x140/0xcd/0x4c/0x4a/0x13/1); reset data_fd2_battle_anim_phase=0; load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1); pan_cursor_and_window(4,0); delay_ms(200); display_dialog_scene(page 1, same geometry); clear_all_chars_facing; pan_cursor_to_char(0). In the binary the page-1 dialog + trailing two calls are a tail-JMP into the shared epilogue at 0x3312D; the trailing 4 calls are also reused as an alt-entry (0x33028) by fd2_chapter_08_init. The src is the functionally-equivalent (Layer 2) straight-line reconstruction.

returns.semantics: No return value; chapter init handler invoked via dispatch table, control returns to the chapter loop.
